description_expanded: Top Reasons to Choose this Vacation Home: * Luxury Mediterranean. 3 Master Suites * 12 ft coffered ceilings, soaring archways, luxury appointments* Pet Friendly Property (Add'l $250 fee)* Private Covered Cabana-Style Pool (Heat Add'l $50/night)* 6-Seater Golf Cart - Optional $75/night. Please note: a $500 refundable deposit is also required.* 4 BIKES Included!* Extras include Beach toys, chairs, a cooler with wheels, and a large dog crate!*2 parking spaces available* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Brozinni Pizzeria, Cafe 30A, Angelina's Italian, or Dough Sea Dough* Under 2 miles to Seaside! * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service**This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. ** *Pets are subject to approval. If you are traveling with a pet, please provide the reservations team with the breed of your pet within 24 hours of placing your reservation.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Come Seas the Day on 30A, and find a luxury, 3-story Mediterranean beach home. This 4-bedroom paradise is pet-friendly and well-appointed and has 5 full bathrooms as well as a powder room and pool half bath. Step through the 8ft mahogany door to be greeted by breathtaking 12ft ceilings, soaring arched entryways, tile and hardwood floors, and a wrought iron staircase! Enjoy cooking a meal in the chef's kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a gas stove, and granite counters. Entertain your guests easily in the open-concept living space or the large outdoor patio area, complete with a brand-new BBQ for grilling, patio furniture, a firepit, and a shaded patio table to enjoy outdoor meals. You will be delighted to find the covered, private cabana-style pool (Heat Add'l $50/night) just out back. Seas the Day on 30A sleeps 14 guests comfortably and features 3 king master suites, a guest bedroom with two full-over-full bunk beds, all of which have their own television.Palmeira Villas at Seagrove Beach is an exclusive, gated community with gorgeous luxury homes, located in the heart of Seagrove Beach on Hwy 30A. Only 1.8 miles from Seaside, this small community offers all the best of 30A without all the hustle and bustle! Hungry? There are many fabulous local restaurants nearby, such as Café 30A, Angelina’s Pizzeria, Dough Sea Dough, and The Perfect Pig Gourmet Market. Come experience Palmeira Villas and see what makes the 30A area world famous!The Bed Setup: 2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedMaster Bedroom: King Bed3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Two Full-over-Full bunk beds (Sleeps 8)Area Attractions: Villa by the Sea is centrally located on 30A with only a short bike ride to the excellent shopping and dining options of Seaside! If you prefer a leisurely stroll, then Café 30A is only minutes away and constantly ranked as one of the best restaurants on 30A. Angelina's is also within walking distance for pasta or pizza. Walk to The Dough Sea Dough for morning donuts or breakfast sandwiches. The Big Chill at Prominence, around 3 miles east, is a great place to take kids, watch an outdoor movie, listen to music or eat at one of the half a dozen unique eateries.Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous, but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
